evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - arpg/CU-Multi: CU-MULTI is a multi-robot dataset that contains two large-scale outdoor sequences collected by a single ground robot on The University of Colorado Boulder campus. · GitHub
evidence.statement: ROS2 recordings pair RGB/depth/LiDAR with timestamped ground-truth path and odometry; use ordered observation/pose sequences, not static maps.
